title: Show Tdarr Matrix Full Progress And Prevent Duplicates
summary: Expose progress and ETA for long Tdarr Matrix runs and prevent launching another incomplete 100 percent matrix run.
reason: A 4,632-row full run is a multi-day sequential proof in the current harness. Without progress/ETA and duplicate-run guards, the operator sees a run that appears unfinished and can accidentally start a second full run.
behavior_before: Diagnostics listed run selected counts and final finding counts, but incomplete full runs had no completed/total progress or ETA. The full button could start another full run even while a previous full run was still incomplete.
behavior_after: Diagnostics reports worker-result progress, processing rate, and ETA for selected Tdarr Matrix runs. A new full action returns the existing incomplete full run instead of launching a duplicate.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies full runs reuse an existing incomplete full run instead of launching another subprocess
tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies existing full-run results render as active warning results
tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies selected run console payload includes worker-result progress
tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies incomplete runs with worker results report processing status
manual_validation: 2026-06-08: Live run read model for run-20260608-044850-full reported 587/4632 worker results, 12.7 percent complete, 84.72 files/hour, and 47.7 estimated remaining hours before the final patch.
rollback_plan: Remove incomplete-full-run detection and progress summary fields; restore full action to always launch a new background run.
notes: Observed run-20260608-044850-full at 582/4632 worker results after about 6.9 hours of worker-result time, estimating about 55.7 hours total at the current rate. A second older full run was also still processing.
